initial_conditions.sampling: nested scrambled6D Sobol; independent species streams; antithetic phase pairs

backend.pair_law: symmetric full-3D Plummer; exact unordered pair coverage
backend.summation: per-call thread-local double buffers, fixed thread-order merge

integrator: H4 Hamiltonian composition; positive-time end-of-step elastic operator

profile.convention: density shells (lo,hi]; enclosed gravity includes all supplied species; radial averaging is diagnostic only

relaxation.assumptions: weak uncorrelated softened encounters; local virial speed and scale R; explicit multicomponent Neff substitution; no guarantee for tides, collective noise, or density slopes
